proves.claim: With runs_store on, one serve reconciler tick applies a receipt left unapplied in the runs inbox.

cli.io-reconcile.tick-applies-inbox.why: Without it, a receipt stranded by a crash between the board move and the ack would never apply while serve runs.

proves.claim: After three receipts and one tick with runs_store on, the inbox holds no unapplied receipt.

cli.io-reconcile.tick-drains-three-recei.why: Without it, a tick that applies only one receipt would leave the others stranded.

proves.claim: With runs_store off, a serve reconciler tick opens no runs file.

cli.io-reconcile.flag-off-opens-no-runs-.why: Without it, a board that never turned the flag on would grow a runs file.
